headline: A 2014 law renames the VA Vet Center in Prescott, Arizona, after Dr. Cameron McKinley.
what_it_does: This law gives the Department of Veterans Affairs Vet Center in Prescott, Arizona, a new name: the "Dr. Cameron McKinley Department of Veterans Affairs Veterans Center." It is a naming change only. The summary does not describe any change to services, funding, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 25, 2014.
